snippet.title: SNES Longplay [508] Donald Duck no Mahou no Boushi
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: SCHLAUCHI

Japan only Disney platformer.
At the start you have to earn money with minigames.
You dont have to do all of them to earn enough money for the necklace, but i show all of them anyway! -
